propositions: A new bug_trends lens must aggregate 344 closed bugs across five dimensions: close_class distribution by month, detected_by distribution, open-bug age percentiles, caused_by fan-in per target, and time-to-close percentiles.
Pre-convention bugs without close_class (approximately 214 records) must be surfaced as an explicit labeled MISSING cohort rather than silently dropped or merged, to prevent taxonomy-era skew.
The detected_by field is sparse and currently absent from all bugs; when absent everywhere, that dimension must degrade to unavailable state without affecting other dimensions.

Flow dimensions (close_class-by-month, time-to-close) filter on close transition timestamp within the CLI range; stock dimensions (age percentiles, detected_by distribution, caused_by fan-in) measure point-in-time over the current store and ignore the range.
Zero-bug and edge-case stores must return unavailable state per registry convention rather than crashing or producing empty results.
